props.nameDescription: This name identifies the agent in the Studio and in the app. The agent does not know it: when asked for its name, it does not answer with this one. To give it a name, write it in the instructions.

schemaBuilder.empty: No fields yet. Add a field to get started.
schemaBuilder.descriptionPlaceholder: Question or hint the assistant uses to fill this field
schemaBuilder.orderQuestionsHint: When on, the assistant asks for each field in the order below. Turn off to let it choose the order.
schemaBuilder.enumValuesHint: The assistant may only pick one of these values.
schemaBuilder.rangeHint: Optional. Leave a bound empty to keep that side unbounded.

props.agentSessionCategoriesInUse: Categories already used in this agent's conversations cannot be unchecked.

placeholders.instructions: Enter instructions for the agent to follow when responding to user input
placeholders.greeting: Optional greeting the agent sends first when a new conversation starts

validation.nameMinLength: Name must be at least 3 characters
validation.outputJsonSchemaInvalid: Output JSON schema must be a valid JSON object

defaultPromptDialog.title: Instructions
defaultPromptDialog.description: These instructions define the behavior of the agent.

mcpServers.label: MCP Servers
mcpServers.emptyDescription: Add MCP servers to this project to give your agents access to external tools.
mcpServers.builtInDescription: Built into the platform, no configuration needed.

unsavedChanges.title: Unsaved changes
unsavedChanges.description: You have unsaved changes that will be lost. Do you want to discard them?

autosave.refused: This change could not be saved
autosave.unsavedBeforeVersions: Fix the unsaved changes before you manage versions

liveSettings.immediate: A change here applies at once in production.
liveSettings.notice: Changes here apply to the agent in production as soon as you save.

confirmSave.title: Apply these settings now?
confirmSave.description: These changes apply to the agent in production as soon as you save.

create.noDraft: No draft to create. Save a change first to create a new draft version.

placeholders.revisionDesc: Describe what changed in this version

dialog.title: Save version {{revision}}?
dialog.description: Version {{revision}} is frozen. Later changes start a new draft version.

create.setAsProductionDescription: The app, the embed and the public API will start new conversations with it. Otherwise version {{current}} stays in production.
create.firstVersionProduction: This is the first saved version of the agent, so it goes in production.

history.title: Version history
history.description: Browse, compare and restore the versions of {{name}}, and choose the one in production.
history.comparing: Showing changes from version {{before}} to version {{after}}.
history.noChangesDescription: These two versions have identical settings.
history.onlyVersionDescription: This agent has a single settings version, so there is nothing to compare yet.

restoreDialog.title: Restore version {{revision}}?
restoreDialog.description: The settings of version {{revision}} are copied into the draft, so you can edit them and save them as a new version. The version in production does not change.

version.ariaLabel: Settings version new messages run with

orchestration.emptyDescription: This agent answers directly without delegating to another agent.
orchestration.noAvailableAgents: No other conversation agents are available.
orchestration.modeRelayHint: The orchestrator calls this agent for one exchange and answers the user itself.
orchestration.modeHandoffHint: This agent talks to the user directly until its part is done, then hands the conversation back.
orchestration.unpublishedHint: Not offered to the orchestrator until it is published.

embed.enabledDescription: Makes {{name}} available outside the platform: the widget, the public page and the public API. When off, all three stop working.
embed.snippetDescription: Paste this <script> tag before the closing </body> tag on each page where the chat widget must appear.
embed.snippetHint: Optional attributes: data-color="#2563eb" (button color), data-locale="fr" (widget language), data-display-mode="drawer" (side panel instead of bubble), data-hint="Need help?" (tooltip shown on load and hover).
embed.publicPageDescription: Share this link, or a QR code of it, to make {{name}} available without a host website.
embed.publicPageHint: The page only works while embedding is enabled. Add &locale=fr to force the language.
embed.allowedOriginsDescription: Leave empty for now. The widget calls the platform from {{embedOrigin}}, not from your website: a list without this address blocks the widget. The check of the website that shows the widget is not available yet.
embed.titleDescription: Title shown in the chat header. Defaults to {{name}} when left empty.
embed.logoUrlDescription: URL of the logo image shown in the chat header.
embed.primaryColorDescription: Primary color used in the chat widget header. Enter a hex value (e.g. #2563eb).
embed.bannerTextDescription: Optional notice pinned above the conversation, on the public page and in the widget. Use it to state the context, such as a test version or the intended audience.
embed.bannerTextPlaceholder: Test version, for the pilot team only

appearance.title: Appearance
appearance.description: Shown in the header of the widget and of the public page.

apiSection.title: Public API
apiSection.description: To build your own chat interface, call the API directly instead of using the widget.

embed.apiBaseUrlDescription: Every route of the API starts with this URL. It contains the embed token of this agent.

promptVariables.title: Prompt variables
promptVariables.description: Default values for the variables the agent declares in its instructions. Used when a session starts without a value for one of them.

generation.title: Answer generation
generation.description: The model that writes the agent's answers.

priorityCalls.title: Priority calls
priorityCalls.description: Lower and more stable response time, at a higher cost per call.

embeddingModel.title: Document search
embeddingModel.description: The model that finds the passages of the project's documents that match each question.
embeddingModel.help: A model appears once the project finished embedding its documents with it.

fillForm.title: Form filling
fillForm.description: Let the agent fill a structured form from the user's answers during the conversation.
fillForm.schemaDescription: Define the form fields the agent should fill. The field order is the order in which the agent asks its questions.

followUpSuggestions.title: Suggest follow-up questions
followUpSuggestions.description: After an answer, the agent can suggest short questions that the user can click to continue the conversation.
followUpSuggestions.instructionsDescription: Optional. Tell the agent when and how to write the questions.
followUpSuggestions.instructionsPlaceholder: For example: only when the answer contains a difficult term.

memory.title: Memory
memory.description: Let the agent remember facts about each signed-in user between conversations. Users see and delete what it remembers.

notifications.productionSetError: Could not change the version in production

documents.title: Documents
documents.description: The project's documents the agent searches to answer.

production.noneDescription: Save a version to make this agent available in the app, the embed and the public API.

dialog.title: Put version {{revision}} in production?
dialog.description: The app, the embed, the public API and the agents that call this one will start new conversations with version {{revision}}. Conversations already started keep their version.
dialog.replaces: Version {{current}} leaves production. It stays in the history, and you can put it back at any time.

production.description: The app, the embed and the public API start new conversations with this version.
production.openHistory: Open the version history to change the version in production
